newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends off peaks, cocoa near lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends off peaks, cocoa near lows.

text.p: COFFEE - Sheds some gains as origins emerged to sell after
earlier advance on funds, trade buying. May ends $37 up at
COCOA - Lower across the board. Volume razor-thin. May ends
eight stg down at 1,017 stg, just off day's low of 1,016.
SUGAR - Still weak in solid trading but prices managed to bounce
back from the lows. May off 10 cents at $308.50 by 1608 GMT.
